notes.title: Move / Copy & Paste Update🤯
notes.notes:
Hello Enjenirs!

We’ve just dropped yet another big update yet, featuring the highly-requested "Move / Copy / Paste" feature, as well as a building precision mode, some new content creator themed character models, and lots more quality-of-life improvements and fixes. Full breakdown below! 👇

🛠️ Major New Features

Move & Copy Mode:
One of the most requested features is finally here! You can now select multiple objects using the Select Tool and either move them or copy & paste them.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/58adf9d587e290abb2faf6569ba5a06675c79943.gif"]As simple as it sounds to make, there is so much going on under the hood with different physics constraints and connections that this feature was much harder than you would have thought! But it's here now, and being able to Move and Copy selections makes it far easier to duplicate complex builds, reposition entire contraptions, or just experiment with layout changes.
It is only available in Sandbox Mode - as it's currently breaks the missions, but we'll continue to expand and refine this system and will add more functionality over time - and it’s already a powerful new tool for your creative toolkit! 

Precision Mode:
A new toggle that allows for much finer rotation and scaling increments when building. Great for lining things up at specific angles or making detailed adjustments!

Mass Display in Selection:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/e6c1ffac0b4f16d516fca4abdfc320c4af44fb44.jpg"]Selected objects now display their mass in kilograms (kg), helping you make better-informed design decisions.

🎮 Content Creator Additions
Real Civil Engineer, Martincitopants and Robbaz
Three content creators now appear in-game with their own playable characters and custom missions!
To unlock them as playable characters, go to Settings > Enable Content Creators.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/89911a3f8c6afe608f3eb04b40255c2479e14634.png"]
🌴 Final Level Progress - Endgame Island Sneak Peak
We’ve been working on the final level of the game: Endgame Island.
It’s still in development, but here's a sneak peak... This is a major step towards our full 1.0 release - more on this soon!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/24c9c441e23ce7bcea3842267ef849fe1274e718.png"]
🔧 Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements
 All scroll bars are now much wider and easier to use
 Alt Wheels can now be included in the "Disable Physics" selection system.
Improved Selection Tool: You can now select all object types
 You can now rebind the following inputs:
 Left click
    Right click
    Scroll up / down
    Middle mouse
    Skip build
    Speed up / slow down build
    Toggle Precision Mode
    Fixed broken collision on the "Brig O’ No Return" mission
Lighthouse and bell now correctly disable their collisions when the mission is inactive

Also, we'll be launching our next Community Challenge at the end of this week, so keep an eye out for that soon!

Once again, thank you all your continued feedback, bug reports, and support.

We’re getting closer and closer to full release, and this update is another big step in that direction.

As always, let us know what you think, share your builds, and consider leaving a Steam review if you're enjoying the enjeniring!

Stay enjenious,

Cillín & Neil

notes.title: 🧙‍♂️ The Enjenir V0.7 - The Unhinged Update 🤯
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/4890cf602582ffd308dadf7eca3b4e7e9f391651.jpg

Hello Enjenirs!

This major update brings some serious upgrades to your builds, adds a brand new level to explore, and introduces two game-changing components: hinges and springs! Plus, we've made key improvements to building mechanics!  

More info below 👇

✨ New Content

New Level: Explore the mysterious realm Under Beinn Dreich - our latest level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/3134556b537b7b3ac1ebee7d9e4f0faf164b5825.png
This level sits between the Farm and the Seaside level - so relatively early enough in the game. One of the bits of feedback we get from folk was that the difficulty of the missions ramps up quite quickly, so this level should help to ease into the more difficult missions in the later levels.

Springs: One of our most highly requested feature - Springs! Easily create bouncy contraptions!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/b8306de35cee82f5a976089b2aedc52fd605d886.gif
These springs also have with tweakable parameters allowing you to change Stiffness, Dampening, and it's Target Position.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/4439bff7a15ff042009031c179495772c234f926.gif
Some players have already started integrating them into their vehicle designs to add working suspension!

Hinges: With this update, The Enjenir is significantly less unhinged thanks to... hinges! Now you no longer need to use convoluted rotator systems to emulate hinge-like features because you have... actual hinges!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/952110c42d8df4f18f49bdabc22fafdd8897b66a.jpg


⚙️ Improved Mechanics

Revamped rotator physics (no more random stops and now are way more reliable)
Gradual braking system added to Rotators to avoid sudden stops
Piston reliability has been improved - now with over 76% fewer random piston explosions! 🤯


🔧 Minor Fixes & Tweaks

 Painting is now enabled on the new wheel system
 Bracing can now attach to the new wheels
 Reduced anvil placement offset to make it easier to place anvils
 Various other bug fixes and optimizations 


🚀 Coming Soon
We’re also planning our next community challenge which we will reveal more info on soon… and the submission will be a lot easier now, as it will be directly incorporated into the Steam Workshop!

Thanks once again to everyone for continuing to play and enjoy The Enjenir. As always, drop us a Steam review if you're enjoying the game's chaos, or perhaps it's precise engineering… depending on your playstyle! 😉

All the best,

Cillín & Neil

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/a5a940d56956bc3f0b9d2bd4cbab9abc4d094f18.jpg

notes.title: The Enjenir - V0.6 MAGNET UPDATE 🧲
notes.notes:
The Enjenir V0.6 🛠️

Hey everyone, a nice big update for all you enjenirs out there, full of a mix of new content, new mechanics, improvements and more! 👋

New Content 🧩

Added Magnets to the game 🧲 And not just any magnets - these are monopole magnets - that are technically electromagnets - since you can use the wiring system to turn them on and off with the touch of a key!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/a7fabc460e4f65c98ec1a41ab74da6c5c1268cf0.gif
Brand New Wheel System - allowing a lot more flexibility when placing wheels. You can now use a "wheel only" system to place them centrally, as well as thickening them up! You can even place them directly inside a beam be press Left Shift - and use the select tool to make them fixed to that beam, or allow them to freely rotate - this should make vehicle building much easier!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/1e13481a48acbd750966417fb87551ba475a68a8.jpg
Creative Sandbox mode in any level - get full sandbox features to build anything in any level - and share them on the steam workshop!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/ce4aa21e592bf379b65665cc41805763ed895fbe.jpg
Added some playable Content Creators 3D to play as, or use as NPCs - Enable them in the settings!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/b26d05c0f753614eadf47e3e800d01a24f120f09.jpg
Recognise this creepy face? 👀 
More characters to follow - let us know who you want to see in the game!


New Features ⚙️

New Selection Tool
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/74b11cb10aea39d29d8dc3ff38ef7dc122afa281.jpg You can now use the select tool to select lots of items at the same time. At the moment, you can use this tool in sandbox mode to manually turn off physics for specific items. This makes things like building tracks, rollercoasters or certain structures easier (rock solid structures) while still having dynamic physics on moving parts (trains, vehicles etc.) There's also the added bonus of less items simulating physics = better performance!

Added a toggle in the settings which enables the automatic skipping of the building animation. If you're sick of speeding up the building timelapse, or clicking the skip button - you can now just change the settings to automatically always skip the building animation.
Added a visual indicator to show which way propellers will push.
Added the gap check from the rectangular sheets to the triangular and circular sheets.
Added a visual indication of the magnetic field of each magnet when selected using selection tool.
Decreased loading time significantly.
You can now scale decouplers.
Sandbox mode now allows you to:

Quit without saving (no more Alt-F4!)
Save without quitting
Rebalanced some missions:

Added magnets to certain missions
Bombs removed from pangolin mission
Command Chairs added to relevant missions
Removed vertical speed from water speed record mission

Added some easter eggs for some of our master enjenirs 👀


Bug Fixes 🐞

Fixed the bug relating to propellers not reversing when you don't manually control them.
Fixed the propellers randomly losing power.
Fixed bug where you would place an item while clicking on the menus


Physics Building Games Bundle 🛠️

 We've also recently bundled up with the awesome engineering game GearBlocks in our super imaginatively named "Physics Building Games" bundle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/36465b621dbdbbbbbc3392488b090137502858f3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/2821cfdd9c92c00544d98feb3cc2efaef0f03829.jpg
 For anyone that already owns The Enjenir, you can get a 10% discount off GearBlocks (and vice-versa!) so we recommend checking out GearBlocks from our friends over at SmashHammer Games if you're into physics building engineering games!

Thanks again to everyone for playing The Enjenir and reading this, remember to leave a Steam review if you are enjoying all these changes - every positive review helps us massively - algorithmically, mentally , emotionally and probably spiritually! 😂

Many thanks,

Cillin and Neil 🚀

notes.title: The Enjenir V0.5 HUGE UPDATE + STEAM WORKSHOP! 🤯
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We have yet another huge update for you today, which includes one of the most requested features for the game finally here - Steam Workshop Support! The other changes are listed at the bottom of the patch notes, but the main ticket item is Steam Workshop features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/220e18de633a5284689f6e8392303178ebe07876.png

In its current state, the Steam Workshop integration allows players to easily share / upload / download your favourite saves - all within the game!

To view all the builds that have been uploaded, from the Main Menu - just click "Browse Workshop"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/f22bb078c68cdef6011a91b5554d632c6249bf60.jpg

Once in this menu, you can browse through all the uploaded builds already available, and download the ones you want. Usually, if the contraption is controllable using the wiring system - they controls/keys are usually written in the description. Once downloaded, you can open them up straight away! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/15fb9578171b0daa87ddf913a6a215747dd399ad.jpg

From here, you can view and play with the build, make tweaks and changes as you see fit! Once you are done, you can choose to "Save and Quit" and save your modified version of the build directly to a creative slot in the Sandbox mode, or you can just quit without saving.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/6e82f0ffd8bce5551a52a535c1c1fd150a7d0418.jpg

"But don't I only have 10 Sandbox Save Slots?!" - Not anymore! We have completely revamped the Creative Mode save system, and you now have the ability to add as many saves as you want! (Technically there is a limit of ~200!) With these new Creative Mode changes comes an overhaul the Creative Mode loading screen to make all these changes clearer! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/928d6c59f4e43a22b80d25defba5480589c1f2cf.jpg

If you wish to add a brand new save slot - you can just click "Add New Save" at the bottom of the screen! We've also simplified how you can rename the Save slots, so you can remember what is in each save. We hope these new changes and the refreshed interface makes life easier to manage all your saves without needing to override olds ones :)

If you want to upload any of your builds to the Steam Workshop, simply pause the game and hit "Upload to Workshop" - remember to add a description and the key bindings for any controllable elements to it! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/acb4444b0a169d2186d3c1e987fff04e51fb3e6a.jpg

Also, the other changes available in this patch are are as follows:

 Gears are now in the game! They can be placed onto surfaces, but also centrally along beams and logs. To switch between placing a gear flat on a surface, or centrally along a beam/log - just hit the Toggle button, which is set to "Shift" by default!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/efa8503b9172d1d4197e0e3643cc79f611bc068f.jpg

 Added the "Photo Mode - Screenshots Folder" link to open the folder within the game
Expanded the "Copy Tool" The tool now includes two different functions:  

Copy Member  
This is the existing "Copy" tool that has been available for months, now renamed to "Copy Member." It allows you to duplicate a specific member's shape/rotation, etc.  
Copy Properties  
This tool allows you to click on a member and apply all its settings (e.g., wiring, aerodynamics) to another member of the same type.  
For example: If you have 20 Wyvern Enjines, you only need to wire one with all the commands you want. Then, use Copy Properties to apply the same settings to all other Wyvern Enjines, saving you from wiring them individually.

Hope everyone enjoys this update, please feel free to upload your builds to the workshop and myself and Neil will be checking them out!

As always, thanks for your support, please consider throwing a thumbs up / positive review on steam if you haven't already, and keep an eye out for more updates coming that we coming... Here is a sneak peak of one feature we're working on...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/66d8e742750e4c80106fc9b540f65c6212b4e949.gif

👀👀👀👀

Any how, that's all for now. Enjoy the update, and let's see your structures and contraptions!

All the best,

Cillin and Neil

notes.title: 🚁 Aerodynamics Update ✈️
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we’ve just dropped a new update to The Enjenir introducing Aerodynamics! 🤯

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/705bedba17750971417d87496b4cbf7ff516752c.png
This new mechanic allows players to create different types of flying contraptions, like the example below from one of our beta testers:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/76338e5ad55e85d78872ded1bcf6da14af5b02cd.gif

In this example, 100% of the lift and steering is generated from aerodynamic forces applied to some really clever flap designs—how cool is that?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/1c237c92530e678c9e23d97a1fd9bf2eb28eeebe.gif

How does it work?
Now, we're obviously not running NASA grade Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) for our aerodynamics calculations... we are trying to run an actual game at 60fps here! 🙂 What we have done though, is a really streamlined (no pun intended) and simpler system that helps simulate aerodynamics in an efficient way, calculating the velocity of a given sheet, with a force applied proportionally to the normal of it's largest face... Simple!

How do I enable aerodynamics?
For stability, performance and gameplay reasons, these aerodynamic forces are only applied to sheets with their “Aerodynamics Enabled.” Enabling it for a given sheet is super simple! Just click on a sheet using the Select Tool, and tick “Aerodynamics Enabled", as shown in the image below:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/e2cf4ec2eb7170909755b7c121366f13b0587c7c.png

And yes, it’s even possible to use these properties to create functioning helicopters! Yes, once again - 100% of the lift on this helicopter is generated through the aerodynamic forces of the propellors pushing the helicopter upwards! Making these contraptions really made us appreciate how complex the mechanics of a helicopter really are...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/34acabc42b767833c17a48c3c274c6f989ea6ca2.gif

Also, interestingly - the forces also work in water - so you can use the aerodynamics to create an actual functioning rudder in the water!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/174116361aec02428f3bc6a42df6f50096abd24a.gif

What’s next?
We’ll be closely monitoring how players use Aerodynamics and we will continue to tweak and improve the mechanics throughout Early Access. 

Our next update is likely to a big one, as we're hoping to add Gears back into the game, as well as integrated Steam Workshop support to make it super easy to share builds between players! No ETA on that just yet, but keep your eyes peeled!

Once again. thanks so much to everyone for all your support as we continue to build The Enjenir!

– Cillín & Neil

notes.title: Beta Patch Notes: V0.4f 23rd of November
notes.notes:
Hey anyone on the beta branch!

We've just updated the beta branch of the game with some new mechanics that we'd like to have tested 
 / stress tested before it goes live on the main branch hopefully in the next week or so!

If anyone is confused as to why they got an update on the main build of the game last night that took them to 0.4f, and now another update reverted it to 0.4d... it's because I made a booboo and meant to push the build to the beta branch, not the main branch! 😅

So, the main headline items for this 0.4f update to the beta branch that is currently live as of now are:

Aerodynamic Sheets
- These need to be manually enabled on a per sheet basis, so if you use the select tool to click on a sheet, you can enable it to experience aerodynamic forces. This makes it possible to build planes, and even rudders for boats too (as it works under water!)

Gears
- Gears are back in the beta, and have been revamped. Our previous attempt at gears had issues like constantly getting stuck. Due to the physics and gridless nature of the game - if gears pop out of alignment, they have a higher chance of getting stuck (just like real life!) but we've made changes to improve and address that but if people could test it out and give us feedback on them - that would be much appreciated! You have multiple of options when placing them. You can change the scale/thickness, pressing shift will place them inside the centre of a beam/log, you can lock them etc. Lots of options to play with! You can check the guide on the left (with G) to display the options, and click on them with the select tool to make them fixed/locked to what it is attached to.

Photomode UI
- We've rearranged the UI in photomode and added a button in the game that takes you straight to the folder on your computer that has the images. So no more awkwardly searching through folders trying to find them!

Again, if you have any feedback, please post it as a reply below or join us on Discord (usually gets a much more quicker response on discord!)

Many thanks,

Cillín & Neil

notes.title: Demo Update - V0.3a 30th October 2024
notes.notes:
Demo Update V0.3a - 30th October 2024
Hi everyone!

We’ve just dropped a much-needed update that improves the demo in a number of different ways!

The biggest change is that we’ve upgraded the demo to the same new save system that the full game uses. This means that from here on out, progress from the demo will now carry over into the main game! The only downside to this is that the old save system is not backwards compatible with the new save system, so any existing demo progress to date will be lost with this update. Your progress is not totally lost, however, as the files will remain on your computer (they don’t get overwritten!), and you can still access old saves using a legacy branch of the game that we are making available on Steam that you can opt into!

There have been a tonne of optimisations, improvements, and changes throughout the game, which are now carried forward into the demo. The main big ticket item changes are as follows:
    Lighting: The game's entire lighting has been revamped throughout, offering more pleasant levels to look at!    New Characters: New and improved character models have been added to the game!    Improved Building Mechanics:                    New “Click and Drag” building mechanics for different materials, making it easier to design larger structures.            New building materials to play with:                                    Circular sheets                    Triangular sheets                    Pistons                    Wooden Chains                                            Wiring System: A sneak preview of the wiring system is now available in the demo for the first time to test out and make controllable contraptions on the “Kristoffer the Carrot” mission! The only “wireable” material available for testing in the demo is the piston in the carrot level, so just use the select tool to click on a piston, and you can create a controllable contraption!
Thanks again to all for checking out the demo!

Regards,
Cillín & Neil

notes.title: The Enjenir - Version 0.4! [Huge Update 🤯]
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We’ve just released a massive update packed with new content, enhanced building mechanics, better physics, tons of improvements across the board and more!

We're also featuring in a Steam Daily Deal on Saturday 19th of October for 30% off - so if you are looking to buy the game, you know when the next deal is on! ;)

If you already have the game bought, please consider leaving a positive review, as we have currently dropped under the 10 review limit to get a "recent review" score - which would help us massively when the game gets featured by Valve!

Full patch notes are as follows:
[hr][/hr]
🆕 New Level and Missions

    Explore the vast new level of The Great Loch level featuring 9 brand new missions, focused on the new water mechanics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/c97b070a998c978e67a151046f2644c5f290d69b.jpg
[hr][/hr]

    New Characters & Character Selection Screen: Choose between a new and improved enjenir model, as well as some brand new characters! If you prefer the OG Enjenir, he's still available to play as!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/0fb19d843934b98a7bc9592616f751f79277aad8.gif
    Click + Drag Beams & Logs: Place beams and logs much faster using our new click and drag option which makes it much easier to build large structures!

    Improved Sheet Placement: Similarly with sheets, instead of placing every sheet manually, we've now improved the sheet placement system to allow you to click and drag any distance with sheets - and the game will automatically place as many sheets needed to cover the distance.

    “Lock to Plane” for Sheets: This is now a toggle feature (press Shift) to make sheet placement easier (also seen in the gif above!)
    Command Chair: Lock the Enjenir and camera in place when seated in the command chair, making vehicle control much easier! WASDQE bindings with the wiring system are also now supported to make your own custom WASD controls for vehicles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/20a2743d35a0dde40c0d78f622bf082ff38d9c5d.gif
    Cannons Added: Placeable cannons are now available in sandbox mode!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/16dbb243e3c246b687fc77c0b83c8d51f57f08cb.jpg
    Pistons, Rotators, & Wheels: The physics settings within the engine have been tweaked to now ensure that certain physics based items are significantly stronger and more stable. For examples, rotators - which can only twist previously would bend when under enough force. This has been improved which will increase the stability of larger contraptions! Similar changes have been applied to Wheels, and Ropes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/05b699cb8e9a9ef13454f1ac7316aa9fd41ea62f.gif
    New and improved ropes: Ropes in general have been greatly improved and made much more stable and less likely to randomly jank out. Spontaneous explosions have been greatly reduced!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/99f71b3710d996711230f580ec3e338be7ed3e47.gif
    Scalable Balloons: You can now adjust the size of balloons for even more design options. The balloons offer forces proportional to their volume, so instead of using lots and lots of small balloons, 1 medium balloon will offer the same force! Not only does it make your builds slicker and more stable, it also helps performance using one balloon instead of many!

[hr][/hr]🐛 Bug Fixes and General Improvements

    Price Adjustments: Adjusted the cost of balloons, anvils and wyvern engines for better balance.
    Improved Sheet Placement: Sheets now minimize gaps more effectively when placed.
    More Accurate Beam and Log Placement: Precision has been improved for better alignment of structures.
    Wyvern Adjustments: Wyvern weight and force have been rebalanced.
    Fixed a bug where the character would turn upon spawn before player control was established.

    NPC Deletion Bug: Resolved an issue where NPCs could be deleted unintentionally.

    Performance Improvement: Fixed a performance issue with measurement lines that was causing frame rate drops.
[hr][/hr]We hope you enjoy the new update and all the exciting new features and improvements! If you want to give us any feedback, suggestions, or encounter any issues the best place to reach us is on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/a5a940d56956bc3f0b9d2bd4cbab9abc4d094f18.jpg

As always, thanks again to everyone for the support, feedback, positive reviews etc. Everything you folk do makes a big difference to our small team - as yes, it is just still the two of us working on the game part-time!

Thanks again!
Cillín & Neil

notes.title: The Enjenir V0.3 - HUGE UPDATE + WATER PHYSICS! 🤯
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

This is our biggest & coolest update yet - by far! There is so much crammed into this update - so buckle up - it's a big one!

Due to popular demand, we have added water physics! 🤯

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/3bb4ed0ebaec034008c85ab0c75d067931ef7e1a.jpg

Note: In order to make this and planned future updates possible, we had to upgrade to the latest version of Unreal Engine 4, which required a significant amount of rework behind the scenes. Although it comes with a whole raft of benefits, one downside unfortunately is that old saves are not backwards compatible, despite our very best efforts 😭 More info on this below, including how you can still technically play with your old saves if you want - the old saves are not actually lost!

So here's what we have for you in this latest update:

New Water System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/10914430bde8cd48bdfa778617436e4d9e719e2a.jpg
Yes - by popular demand - we've added water... Lots of water... and full on water physics too! This also includes a new water quality. And boy does the new water look so good! Plus - it's actually way more optimised and less taxing on your computer than the previous top quality water!

Buoyancy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/0c719b1b95cadd9ef8415409fd3719fa280b8044.gif
As previously mentioned, this isn't any ol' water - this is fully physics simulated water physics, with buoyancy! All building materials now float, so you can now build floating contraptions (assuming they are well designed...!) that can even be powered using Wyvern Engines, propellers, rotators etc! In the beta, we've already seen submarines, Loch Ness Monsters, Titanics... The possibilities are endless!

To facilitate creating buoyant contraptions, we've added Buoyancy Barrels to the Miscellaneous Chest!

Campaign Mode Overhaul - New Items & Wiring System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/7da5eb0af02c8d1c1a6d57677f3cb51ead246725.gif
One of the biggest changes with this update, is actually within the Campaign Mode. The items available to you in the campaign has been drastically changed. In missions, you now have access to lots of new items that were previously only available in sandbox mode - like balloons, pistons, wyvern rocket engines etc. They are stored within the little Misc Chest - so check them out!

We’ve also enabled the use of the wiring system in missions which allows you to execute commands with keybindings to control contraptions much much easier! I've created a high level guide on how the fundamentals of the wiring system works:
[previewyoutube=80l9OXDo2JU;full][/previewyoutube]

Sandbox Slot in levels 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/5772fa6f678f85b75675975fc6caed1ad16a0cc6.jpg
We’ve added an extra mission to each level, called - Sandbox! This basically enables a sandbox mode in that level! So build and explore in the campaign levels as you wish!

New Item: Decouplers 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/e0643fca5decf3b8c3d12e57c2a686d4734d4f15.gif
These have been added to the game allowing you to decouple parts of your contraptions mid game! You can also recouple them too!

New Save System 
As previously mentioned, since we had to upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.27, we’ve had to overhaul the save system, and how files are saved for the game. For this reason, from this update onwards, old saves will no longer work in the latest version of the game. Trust me, we tried so hard to make them backwards compatible 😓 When you boot the game up - it will appear as all your saves have been deleted.

The old saves are not actually deleted or lost though, and are stored separately from the new saves! We are making these old saves accessible through a "legacy" branch of the game on Steam, if for whatever reason you don't want to lose your old saves/scores or want to revisit old builds etc. To access these, right click on The Enjenir in your library, and in the Beta tab, you can select the Legacy version in the drop down menu, as shown below:{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/a2bc020ec5a4208867c3e41dbaeac3501b507a9f.jpg

Steam Cloud Saves 
In tandem with the implementation of this new save system, we've now enabled Steam Cloud Save functionality, which means saves will be synced to the cloud when you quit the game. So switching between computers etc. will mean you keep your saves! Again, this only currently relates to the new saves created from this update onwards.

Scores Updated
Since the campaign mode has been changed so much, having added a tonne of new building materials etc, as well as the previously mentioned overhaul to our save system in the backend, we’ve also gone and adjusted all the scores of the missions to reflect these changes! So, expect different scores will net you a different grades previously. Since we've effectively had to do a fresh wipe of the saves, this is the perfect time to revisit old levels with the new mechanics and see if you can solve them in new and cool ways!

Character Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/c48adb35602e4541441f721b73d20828b28c06ee.gif
With the addition of water, we’ve updated the character to be able to swim! Hold W to swim, or Shift + W to swim faster! Holding S while in the water will just keep you treading water / upright and stop you from sinking. As you might expect, the swimming is fully physics driven, but super easy to use. The character struggles to walk sometimes, but he is an Olympian swimmer!

General Fixes and Changes
A number of other small changes and bug fixes have been implemented including:

Rebalancing of Wheels
Rebalancing of Rotators
Fixing the googly eye bug
Character UI guide text not disappearing when it should
A bunch of other random minor bugs throughout the game - too long to list!
Phew, that is a lot to take in! So much new content, mechanics and more! 🥳

Once again, thanks for checking out The Enjenir, we really hope you enjoy this update! We're super excited about it ourselves, and what the future holds for the Enjenir! We apologise again for not being able to get the old saves backwards compatible (we tried hard - trust me!) Sorry to anyone that feels they have lost progress - this is something that has really stressed us out! 😓

Oh, and remember, if you like the game - please consider dropping a positive review / thumbs up on Steam etc. etc. 😉 It helps us massively, and we are so close to 400 reviews - only 2 reviews away! 😁

Cillín & Neil 💘

notes.title: Beta Patch Notes: V0.3a 24th July 2024
notes.notes:
Beta Patch Notes: V0.3a 24th July 2024

Hey everyone, just posting the patch notes for the beta branch of The Enjenir, not the base game - which is one of the biggest updates we've put out there yet. This is a HUGE one, with lots of massive changes! Again, this is just within the Beta Branch on steam, and not in the base game yet, so we'll be making a more detailed and fancier patch notes / announcement once we've fixed some issues and polished up certain elements of it. We’re already aware of a few bugs, so if you notice any - you can either post them in the comments here - or leave them in our bug reporting forum on Discord.

As explained in more detail below - this new update contains a new save system, so if you update to the Beta, it effectively treats it as a new game, with no save slots attributed to it. When you revert back to the normal base game, you will get access to your old saves. New saves and Old saves are stored separately. Moving forward with the game, from the next official update onwards, this new save system will be used - so old saves will only be accessible via a Legacy branch of the game that will be made available, which won't have new features etc.


Water 
Yes - by popular demand - we've added water... Lots of water... and full on water physics too! Now you can build floating contraptions! This also includes a new max water quality. After doing some more testing, it ends up what is currently the max water quality settings, is actually one of most optimised, performant and best looking ones - so don't be afraid to use the max water quality - it's much more optimised than some of the lower quality settings! Oh, and it looks amazing!
Character Update
With the addition of water, we’ve updated the character to be able to swim! W swims, and shift + W swims faster!
Misc. Items in campaign
The campaign has been overhauled with respect to what materials you have available to you. You now have lots of the misc. items that were previously only available in sandbox mode, which are now available to use in missions!
Wiring System in campaign
As per the previous point, we’ve now also allowed you to use the wiring system to be able to execute commands and use the interactive materials in game! I'll be making a video/guide on how to use that - and we'll be looking for a way to incorporate information/guide into the game moving forward.
Scores Updated
Since we’ve added a tonne of new materials to the campaign, we’ve had to adjust all the scores of the missions to reflect this! So, expect different scores will net you a different grade.
New Save System 
Since we changed Unreal Engine version (to get water physics and other benefits) we’ve had to overhaul the save system, and how files are saved. For this reason, from this update onwards, old saves will no longer work in the latest version of the game. The files are stored separately, so - if you want - you’ll be able to switch version and see your old saves in an older version of the game. So when you boot the game up in the new Update, it will effectively look like a fresh wipe of the entire game, with no saves appearing in game.
Steam Cloud Saves 
For the new save system in use for the game, all saves will be synced to the cloud using Steams Cloud Save functionality. So switching between computers etc. will mean you keep your saves! Again, this only currently relates to what is currently the Beta save slots, and (from the next main game update onwards) the future saves of the game.
Sandbox Slot in levels 
We’ve added an extra mission to each level, called - Sandbox! This basically enabled a sandbox mode in that level! So build and explore as you wish!
Rebalancing of wheels and rotators 
There has been some rebalancing and optimisations with regards to the wheels and rotators
Decouplers 
These have been added to the game allowing you to decouple materials mid game!
Buoyancy barrels 
With the addition of the water physics, we’ve added buoyancy barrels to help you create floating contraptions!


Again, this is just a beta branch update (to update to the beta branch, right click on The Enjenir in your Steam library, go to properties, Beta Section, and in the drop down choose "Beta" and then update your game) and we’re already aware of a few bugs:

 The character stops swimming if you enter photomode in the water
 There is an invisible end to the water physics volume


Thanks again for checking out The Enjenir. Remember, if you like the game - think about possibly leaving a positive review on Steam etc. etc. 😉

Cillín & Neil

notes.notes:
Patch Notes: V0.2e 13th of June 2024

Hey all, we dropped a nice little update yesterday with a bunch of new content and quality of life improvements added. Nothing drastic or major, but lots of nice changes!

New Features:

 Bill of Quantities - check how much of each material you’ve used on each design! This feature is currently in Beta as we currently rework all the mission scoring for the next big update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/692d8801fb6eb0f7b7894b1f6021885668983c1b.jpg
 New Circular Sheets{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/f19dc69dc424e095245b92f54bdc164aec7a1218.jpg
 Added a brightness slider in settings
 Added Vsync option in settings
 In sandbox mode, we made it possible to change all connection types for bracing (screws, nails, bolts).
 Added the ability to use nail/bolts/screws and bracing onto certain members (static walls, anvils, blocks)
 Added the vegetable cannon (that's a real thing, right?) to the sandbox mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/7f566cc37b1faa57c114aabf7c92f7c61ed74aa9.jpg
 German is now fully integrated into the game!
 "Tidy Mode" added - this restricts the length of nails/screws/bolts to the thickness of what they are going through - so no more spikey nails poking through builds with this turned on!

Improvements:

 Improved rope placement - made it easier to connect at different angles
 Longer ropes - ropes are now much longer!
 Wiring System update: key bindings can be set for pressing and releasing a button. e.g. you can keybind a wyvern engine to turn on when a key is pressed, and turn off when a key is released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/65cd303f93e0c8c38ec6421177a5a86e4a3631e9.jpg
 The green placeholder for building members has been tweak to make none of the outlines stick out - making it easier to accurately place items!
 Made rotator placement clearer by adding centreline to them. 
 Added additional stop and release function to rotators and pistons & added an additional stop function to propellers.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug with construction lines having collision when invisible. 
 Fixes and improvements have been made to the Measurement lines, however there are still a few issues we're working on resolving with them.
 Nail Collision fixed
 Fixed bug where wiring system and structures did not work when you first load a save game
 Fixed bug where deleted members would reappear when you leave a mission in progress.
 Fixed the bug where members were not deleting properly. Some members (end plates) were made invisible but not deleted. 

As we've mentioned elsewhere, we're currently working on upgrading the version of the Unreal Engine we're using to make it easier to add some cool mechanics and features we want to add. More on that soon! In the meantime, we need to wrestle with a bunch of stuff beneath the hood (linked to the save system) that hopefully will get sorted soon!

Once again, thanks again to everyone for the support, and welcome to all the new members of the discord that found us recently! :hearts: 

Cillín & Neil


PS: remember, if you like the game and all these updates, consider leaving a thumbs up / positive review on steam - makes a huge difference to us! 😊

notes.title: The Enjenir V0.2 - Huge Update! 🤯
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: V0.2a 4th of May 2024

Hey everyone, BIG BIG BIG update for you all today!

Full Patch Notes:

New Content:
 New fully integrated level in the campaign mode called “Frozen Peaks” which has 10 brand-new missions!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/36f2dc5972991eaefccd9d8ce246c0b7bcdab753.jpg

 Painting Tool - you can now choose to paint any member a different colour! This comes with a fully integrated colour picker. So unleash your inner Bob Ross! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/4bdc2844ba68d434dfb4d3041282238c8b78322d.jpg

Or you could do like me, & reinforce the stereotype that engineers don't usually make good artists... Exhibit A below...

 Friction Settings - the paint tool also allows you to change a members friction when you paint it - think of it like greasing up something and making it slippy if you remove the friction, or super sticky if you crank it up to the max!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/f1d27d9a12c82b20ee032104d88b9d16e0ce5100.gif

 "Setting Out" tools - We have expanded the tools available to help plan designs and take measurements. Alongside “Construction Lines” are now the “Level Tool” (which gives you a spot level) and the “Measure Tool” which gives you an array of different measurement information. We hope this will improve people's experience and allow you to plan things a little easier!

 The game is now available in French! Et oui! General changes to the game:

 Fixed issue where construction lines were visible when they should not be visible.

Thanks again to each and everyone for your support! Myself and Neil are having a blast developing The Enjenir, and have loved engaging with people on here and on Discord! ♥

Oh, and another friendly reminder if you haven't already, pleaser consider leaving a review on Steam if you can! We are so close to 300 reviews!!

All the best,

notes.title: Patch Notes: V0.1E 1st March 2024
notes.notes:
Hey everyone - another BIG update today!

Lots of changes! We’ve just added interactive functionality into your builds, giving you more of your structures using the new Universal Controllers combined with Pistons and Rotators! Yes, we’ve added working Pistons! Also, did I mention we’ve added the ability to UNDO using CTRL+Z?!

Full patch notes below!

As always, thanks so much for the love and support ❤️  and remember, if you've enjoyed the game please consider leaving us a positive review on Steam (a simple thumbs up on Steam is sufficient!)  - we read each and every one and it really makes a huge difference to us! 😁 

Hope you folk enjoy this one, and looking forward to seeing what


Brand new features!
  Undo function using CTRL+Z. You can now undo the last three steps. This has been a LOT harder to implement than you would think… There are A LOT of moving parts in the code with everything going on, so we’re thrilled to have this added which should remove all the frustrations of accidentally deleting something you didn’t mean to!
 Added a “Select" tool which allows you to tweak properties of certain members after placement.
 Pistons - Pistons are currently found in the Miscellaneous chest in sandbox mode. Once you have placed the piston, use the new select tool, and left-click on a piston to view the changeable properties, like if you want to change their speed, or set their current position to be fully retracted/extended/central. By default, they are set to extend / retract on a loop, however if you select “Manual Control Required” you can then opt to control them using Universal Controllers… What are Universal Controllers? See below:
 Universal Controllers are a new item type which are used to operate members linked to that controller. To link a member with a Universal Controller, use the new select tool to left click on the Universal Controller and choose “Add Links”. Then select each member (piston or rotators for now) that you want that Universal Controller to control. Multiple rotators and pistons can be controlled with the same Universal Controller! Remember to choose “Manual Control Required” for each of those members. Once you have built your structure, now use the select tool again to click on the Universal controller, where you will have the option to control the rotators (start, stop, reverse) and pistons (retract, stop, extend) allowing you to make and control some really cool contraptions!
 Building camera speed is now adjustable by scrolling up and down!
 You can now choose to toggle The Enjenir’s hands to be able to twist or not when grabbed or climbing, using the Left-Alt key. This is indicated via his new colour coded bracelets!
 Green means his hands can twist - which makes it easier for climbing
 Blue means his hands are locked in all rotations - which makes it easier for grabbing things.



Changes / Fixes / Improvements

 Tweaked the values of size and strength of the bombs
 Copy Properties tool works on rotators
 Fixed FPS setting bug.
 Overhauled colour setting - grey scale mode has been phased out, and exposure settings have been optimised which means scenes shouldn’t get as washed out or as dark as they used it.
 Added labels to Misc Items
 Improved Enjenirmobile jumping / double jumping mechanics so he doesn’t lose momentum while jumping.
 Tweaked the enjenirmobile collisions to prevent his legs getting caught on things and janking out.
 Fixed a bug where obstacle course missions would end prematurely if the enjenirmobile broke and fell into the water.

notes.title: Patch Notes: V0.1C 27th January 2024
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: V0.1C 27th January 2024:

Another patch for all you 'enjenirs' out there! One of the main focuses of this patch was a revamp of the save system! Now the campaign has autosave!

Thanks again to everyone for giving us feedback, it's massively appreciated!

And remember, if you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving us a review on Steam - it doesn't need to be wordy (at all) it makes a huge difference to smaller indie games like ours! :)

Full patch notes below:

All levels and missions are now unlocked by default for everyone!
We have added “Autosaving” into the campaign mode, which means your game saves after each mission! This should drastically reduce people losing progress if they crash or Alt-F4. It is still recommended not to Alt-F4 ;) 
We’ve also added the saving of structures when you leave mid-mission. This will allow players to stop a mission, and come back and finish it at another time, without losing any progress.
Your structures for all missions will remain visible while in the mission selection mode - allowing you to admire all of your structures at the same time!
We have added a Potato Spawner into the Sandbox mode, allowing you to spawn a barrel that spawns infinite potatoes. We’ve also allowed you to adjust the lifespan of a potato (i.e before they disappear) to allow you to do some cool stuff, but also optimise performance! This is done with alt+ scroll wheel by default!
We’ve refined and improved bombs - both in how they work, and also the visual effect of the explosion - with new added particle effects for each explosion. You can also now set a specific timed delay (alt+ scroll wheel) on each bomb for coordinated destruction!
The third person character has had some ragdoll/physics improvements to stabilise him further when running and walking.
The character’s climbing has also been improved, with a rework of the different climbing forces, his “grab hitbox” adjusted to make it easier to grab things, as well as and the general physics around how he grabs and climbs things. 
We have added a new guide mode for the character, which highlights his hands in green when he is attached to something. This shows where and when his hand is attached, but also the direction of the pivot point of his hand. This has been enabled by default for the Tutorial and CPD Levels (to help new players adjust to the climbing) and is accessed on other maps using the Guide Key (G), which toggled through the different guide options.
Fixed a bug that caused the character’s hands to jank out when grabbing propellers.
Various bugs have been fixed throughout the game!


Also, we will soon be opening up the Beta to the public who want to opt in, for more info - stay tuned in the Discord server! We are also taking suggestions for features to add to the game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224350/ee032fa14ab0a575e5d51740c76009025eefdeec.jpg

notes.title: Small Update and Patch Notes - 14th Jan 2024
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Firstly, thanks to each and every one of you for your support since launch! The Steam reviews, feedback, community engagement on all platforms that we've seen has really been awesome - myself and Neil are so happy to see so many people enjoy The Enjenir!

It's been just under 4 weeks since launch (including the Christmas break!) but we've been working hard on fixing and improving a number of things in The Enjenir that we wanted to patch ASAP. We've initially focused this early patch on a number of Quality of Life (QoL) updates and bug fixes, but have even included some new features in there too - including a "copy properties" tool to speed up building!

We are still collecting feedback (via Discord, Steam Discussions etc.) and are putting together our Early Access Road Map, which will highlight all the new major changes / features / updates / content that we've got planned for The Enjenir during Early Access! We'll be sharing that with you in the next couple of weeks, and we have some great news to share with you then too!

As for the patch notes, you can find a full list of the main changes here:

There will be changes in this build (like lighter ropes / stronger propellers etc.) that may affect existing sandbox builds - so be wary, this may break some existing structures!
 
New Features:

Added “Copy Properties” tool and hotkey to allow you to quickly clone a selected member. 
Note: this will only fully work on new members being placed post-patch. It will not work fully on existing members from older builds/saves.
 Dynamite has been added to the Sandbox Mode - this is labelled as WIP in the Misc Chest, as it is currently an early prototype, but thought it would be cool to include!
 Added frame rate options in the settings to unlock FPS.
 Added native support for 1280x800, 3840x1200 & 1680x1050 resolutions. 


Quality of Life Updates:

 Added optimal starting building angle for each mission to be aligned to the objective.
 Made propellers more rigid and much more powerful - with size:power ratio now proportional!
 Nails no longer collide with other building members, which leads to fewer clashes when building!
 Ropes are lighter and have slightly less slack
 Tweaked “Trojan Horse” mission difficulty
 Tweaked "Leaky Boat" mission difficulty


Character Update:

 Made turning the character much easier now.
 Stabilised the character overall and improved running over uneven terrain.
 Can run downhill and walk uphill (slowly) more easily without falling.
 The character can now drop from a given height without automatically ragdolling!
 When climbing, the character will continue to turn his body towards where he is looking.
 Fixed some unbalanced forces when pushing/pulling things.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed incorrect scoring in “Leaky Boat” and “Lover's Pathway” mission.
 Fixed “Water Quality” setting not saving correctly
 Fixed “Camera Sensitivity” setting not saving correctly.
 Fixed “All Terrain Vehicle” mission bug where timer didn’t restart, causing you to fail while building.
 Fixed collision bug in Kristoffer the Carrot mission.
 Fixed collisions on Seaside and Sandbox Island.
 Fixed the slow orbit at low frame rates bug.
 Fixed collisions between mortar and beams
 Fixed bug in mekanikal enjeniring mission that allowed you to walk to the end.
 Fixed being able to pass a mission while failing.
 Fixed being able to place mortar when you shouldn’t be able to.

notes.title: Demo Update (New Mission!) + Community Build Challenge
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It is exactly 7 days until we officially launch The Enjenir! 🥳 I can confirm today that 'The Enjenir' will release on the 18th of December at 10AM PST / 6PM GMT!

To celebrate, we are releasing a big patch to the free demo - right now! Although the patch it is crammed full of bug fixes, improvements, optimisations etc. across the board… we have also added a brand new mission for this week's community build challenge! Wooo, new free content!

The mission is called “Kristoffer The Carrot”, and you must build a device, structure or mechanism to unearth a giant carrot from the ground!

To enter the build challenge with your build submission, check out our discord! As part of the judgement criteria for the challenge's nest solutions, we will be looking for highly enjenired devices - with bonus points going to whoever can raise the carrot the highest! Submissions close 15th December at 10am PST / 6PM GMT!

This patch may or may not wipe your old saves, so to get access to the new mission, you need to start a "New Game" - but don't worry, you don't need to complete the tutorial or CPD level any more - you can jump straight to the farm and the new mission!

Full patch notes below!


Patch Notes: Demo V0.1g - 11th December 2023

Building Changes

Member placement is no longer tied to the camera rotation! Easier to build symmetrical structures!
“Toggle Objective” to bring colour to the world or hide the objective models - which are no longer flashing blue!
Snap 90 degree rotations with Shift!
Rotators and Wheels are now scalable!
You can make teeny tiny beams, logs and sheets!
Bracing is lighter and stronger
Construction Lines are scalable
Fixed Connections are slightly weaker
Ability to invert Y axis and mouse sensitivity

Character Changes

You can now aim your hands downwards properly
You can lift heavy items
Throwing items is now possible!
Standing up has been improved and optimised
Crouching has been improved, as well as reaching down and touching the ground.
When reaching out, the character's hands are more stable and less jittery.
You can now zoom in and out while controlling the third person character using the scroll wheel. Middle Mouse Button resets to standard.
First person mode! Hit Enter to enter first person mode! First person parkour!
Hold to Sprint now and no longer a toggle.

General Updates

Added new Mission to Farm!
Added Subtitles to Tutorial and CPD
Improved Farm Obstacle Course meshes in Farm
New Photo-mode! Pause and take amazing high resolution screenshots!
Lots and lots and lots of bug fixes!

notes.title: 'The Enjenir' - Release Date - 18th December!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are super excited to FINALLY be able to announce both the release date AND the launch price of The Enjenir!

We have always promised two things… that the game would release in Early Access “before the end of 2023” and that we were “aiming for $15 at launch”... Well, we can now confirm that the release date is officially the 18th of December - and that not only are we sticking to the $15 price… we’re actually giving a launch discount of 10%, which means the price at launch will actually be [strike]$15[/strike] $13.50 for a limited time only at launch!

Thanks again to everyone for your support and patience. We’re at the final sprint now towards launch, and can’t wait to see what you guys come up with in all the wild and wacky missions we have planned, as well as the unlimited creative sandbox mode!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo V0.1e - 10th October 23
notes.notes:
Just a super small hot patch to fix some game-breaking issues that prevented some players playing the game.


 Added support for a wider range of resolutions. Previously the main menu was obstructed for people playing in certain non 16:9 resolutions which prevented them playing the game! Let us know if anyone still has issues here!
 If you fall off the map in the farm level, a bug would happen that would break the character in that game save making the game unplayable. In  New Game Save  slots, if you fall off the map, you warp back up to the map which should prevent this bug! This is only fixed in New Game Save slots, so old save slots will still have the bug if you fall off!
 We've made it clearer now when saving happens, and when saving doesn't happen. Alt-F4'ing will still cause you to lose any progress. When quitting the game, quit the game all the way back to the main menu to ensure your game saves correctly!
